Subject: Next steps: ML/Infra handoff and 90m technical session

Thanks again for the productive conversation this morning, Arya — great context on the retrieval/embedding flows and the latency sensitivity for your customer portal. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can get the right folks aligned: 

Recap (short):
- Primary workload: embedding + retrieval for portfolio analytics, multi-tenant production traffic, real-time UI queries.
- Scale signal: sustained ~150–250 rps of inference with bursts up to ~500 rps; typical request token lengths ~60–250 tokens.
- Security/ops: VPC connectivity required, SOC2 evidence requested, 90-day data retention preference, and strict IAM controls.
- Success criteria: 95th pctl latency target <= 200ms for most user queries; cost threshold will be a gating factor for model choice.

Ask: to size and scope this properly, our ML + infra teams would like a 60–90 minute technical handoff / deep technical session (I recommend 90 minutes to leave room for a short demo + Q&A). Proposed focus: model sizing & routing, KV/prefix caching strategy, quantization options, SLOs / observability hooks, and VPC/security integration.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 17 — 10:30am–12:00pm PT
- Wed Nov 18 — 1:00pm–2:30pm PT
- Thu Nov 19 — 8:30am–10:00am PT

Attachments: I’m attaching a short draft agenda and an SOW stub to help guide the conversation (quantfolio-sow-draft.pdf, redwood-tdx-90m-agenda.pdf). Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (engineer, product, security)? Also — can you share a redacted sample query shape or a tiny CSV of sample requests so we can pre-run a quick sizing estimate?

If none of the times work, publish a couple options and we’ll flex. Once you confirm I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in Dev (infrastructure), Marcus (ML infra), and Karthik (solutions engineering) to cover integration and deployment patterns.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks — looping in a quick draft of what we’ll cover. Appreciate the CSV sample, that’ll help with initial throughput/kv-cache sizing.

Suggested final agenda (90m):
- 0–10m: Intros + goals for session (QuantFolio objectives)
- 10–30m: Workload profile & sample traffic review (we’ll walk through your CSV)
- 30–55m: Model sizing exercise (latency/cost trade-offs, recommended variants & quantization)
- 55–75m: Integration patterns (API, prefix/KV caching, batching, telemetry)
- 75–85m: Security & deployment (VPC peering, Okta SSO flow, audit logs)
- 85–90m: Next steps / owners / action items

Requests before the call:
- Please upload the redacted sample-data-spec.csv to the Drive link or reply to this thread.
- If you have a representative request/response pair (raw JSON), paste a short example — it helps us tune batching and token estimates.
- Confirm attendee list and whether recording is OK.

We’ll bring Dev (infra) to drive the VPC and telemetry discussion and Karthik (solutions) for API integration examples. If 90m feels long, we can aim for 75m and leave follow-ups. I’ve attached the formal session agenda (redwood-tdx-90m-agenda.pdf).
